chunks: The Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me of it from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from 'Ali ibn al-Hakam, from 'Uthman ibn 'Abd al-Malik, from Abi Sa'id al-Mukari, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
If a mouse falls into the well and its skin comes off, then draw out seven buckets from it. Thus this report came as an explanation for all the reports.

key_terms.الْبِئْرِ: the well from which water is drawn and whose ruling is being addressed
key_terms.الْخَبَرُ: the report; this hadith as a transmitted narration
key_terms.الْفَأْرَةُ: a mouse; the animal whose falling into the well is discussed
key_terms.دِلَاءٍ: buckets; the measure for removing water from the well
key_terms.سَبْعَ: seven; the specified number of buckets to be drawn
key_terms.فَانْزَحْ: draw out; an instruction to remove water from the well
key_terms.فَتَسَلَّخَتْ: its skin came off; indicating decomposition of the mouse
key_terms.مُفَسِّرًا: clarifying; explaining and specifying the meaning of other reports

ai.seo_question: What should be done if a mouse falls into a well and decomposes in it according to al-Istibsar?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a well into which a mouse has fallen and decomposed such that its skin has come off. It states that seven buckets should be drawn from the well, and notes that this report serves to clarify the other narrations on the subject.
